title: Require hash-verified source and feature-snapshot provenance before scoring forecasts
accepted_controls: ForecastLedger requires a hash-bearing source registry by default.
The explicit allow_unverified_sources=True option is limited to isolated tests/development and marks the forecast as unverified.
Each feature snapshot has a source_id that must appear in the forecast source_ids.
The feature snapshot SHA-256 must match the content hash recorded in the source registry.
Every forecast source ID must resolve to a registered content hash.
The outcome price source ID must resolve to a registered content hash.
Metrics return no accuracy, Brier score, log loss, calibration or skill claim when any forecast/outcome provenance is unchecked, ID-only or hash-mismatched.
SourceRegistry objects are accepted; inactive, inaccessible or revalidation-required records are rejected.

unresolved_design_gaps.finding: The ledger records issued_at_utc but does not generate a trusted append-time recorded_at_utc or distinguish LIVE forecasts from HISTORICAL_REPLAY records.
unresolved_design_gaps.risk: A caller could backfill a forecast with an earlier issued_at/data_cutoff after its horizon has elapsed; the ledger could then score it alongside genuine live paper forecasts.
unresolved_design_gaps.required_design: Add system-generated ledger_recorded_at_utc, explicit forecast_mode LIVE or HISTORICAL_REPLAY, replay_run_id and point-in-time dataset identity. Live mode must enforce bounded issuance clock skew; replay metrics must be separated from live/shadow metrics.

unresolved_design_gaps.finding: The ledger records model_id and model_version but does not require a registered model-artifact hash.
unresolved_design_gaps.required_design: Register model artifact and configuration hashes; persist them in each forecast and evaluation protocol.

unresolved_design_gaps.finding: The baseline record stores ID, version, probabilities and trained-through cutoff but not a baseline artifact/source hash.
unresolved_design_gaps.required_design: Register baseline model/configuration hash and include it in protocol identity.

policy: No forecast may be admitted to live or shadow performance metrics until source, feature snapshot, model artifact and append-time issuance provenance are verified.
